properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's runtime hash: every token verification hashes the message with keccak256 (hashPersonalMessage) and derives the signer address with keccak256 (publicToAddress). This is the shipped, actively-used hash of the whole protocol; PQ-acceptable (Grover halves 256-bit preimage resistance to 128-bit).
